writtenAlongsideRatherThanOver: checkpoints.json (an earlier PF05 shift) survives byte-for-byte.
note: One checkpoint per family, written and pushed as that family finished rather than batched.

checkpoints.closedAtIs: the UTC date of this shift. This lane has no trusted wall clock beyond the date, so the time component is zeroed rather than invented.

stoppedFamilies.shortWhy: All four declared digests resolve and were re-hashed from bytes, but the four held binaries are editions of different New Hampshire courts. NHJB-2311-Se offers Superior Courts only, NHJB-2328-DFPe offers no Superior Court, and NHJB-2956-FPe offers neither tier this route files in. No one court can be named across the packet and no form carries a free-text court field.
